intro: Choose where the app reads your save and how live stats and prices behave. Changes save automatically.
settingsApiNotLoaded: Settings API is not loaded. Quit the app completely and start it again (after git pull, restart npm run dev too).

language.label: Language
language.restartHint: Other windows will pick up the new language on restart.

saveFile.savePickerNotLoaded: Save picker is not loaded. Restart the app and try again.
saveFile.couldNotOpenPicker: Could not open the save file picker.

savePolling.rollingWindowHint: Changing this resets the current session.
savePolling.rollingWindowConfirm: Changing the rolling window resets your current session stats and history. Continue?
savePolling.rollingWindowSuccess: Session stats were reset for the new rolling window.

notifications.intro: Sound alerts play in the app when enabled below. App updates can show a Windows notification when that option is on.
notifications.notifyOnUpdate: Notify when an app update is available
notifications.soundVolumeHint: Applies to all notification sounds below. Windows update toasts are not affected.
notifications.inventoryThresholdHint: Notifies once your unlocked inventory slots reach this fill percentage.

windowTray.trayHint: Closing the main window keeps TBH Companion running in the system tray. Use Quit from the tray menu to exit fully.

advanced.diagnosticsIntro: When reporting an issue, you can send the diagnostic log file from Settings.
advanced.clearDiagnosticLogsConfirm: Delete diagnostic log files? Use this if logs grow large. XP history CSV is not removed.
advanced.dataCacheIntro: Cached prices and tracker data live in your app user-data folder. config.json is never removed by these actions.

prices.label: Clear Steam Market prices
prices.confirm: Remove all cached Steam Market prices? Inventory values will need to be fetched again from the Market tab.

lookup-prices.label: Clear Lookup market prices
lookup-prices.confirm: Remove the cached Lookup price snapshot? It will be downloaded again on the next check.

box-timers.label: Reset stage boss chest tracker
box-timers.confirm: Reset stage boss chest tracker timers and enabled routes to defaults? Active cooldowns will be cleared.

session.label: Clear session snapshot
session.confirm: Clear the saved session snapshot and reset live stats? Your current session totals and history will start fresh.

all-except-config.label: Clear all except settings
all-except-config.detail: All caches above; config.json is kept
all-except-config.confirm: Clear all cached data except config.json? Catalog, prices, box timers, and live session stats will reset.

messages.clearCacheApiNotLoaded: Clear-cache API is not loaded. Restart the app and try again.
messages.diagnosticsApiNotLoaded: Diagnostics API is not loaded. Restart the app and try again.
messages.nothingToClear: Nothing to clear — those files were already missing.
messages.nothingToClearLogs: Nothing to clear — log files were already missing.
